name: phone-drop
description: Drop files between your computer and your phone over local Wi-Fi: scan a QR code to download to the phone or upload from it. Optional 'open in app' handlers, with Feather (.ipa sideloading) built in.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: auto = HTTPS once the one-time certificate setup is done, otherwise plain HTTP (no setup needed). https = always require the certificate. http = never use it.

apps.title: Open-in apps
apps.description: Apps a file can be opened in, as name=URL template. {url} is the file's HTTPS link, {url_encoded} the percent-encoded form. Example: myapp=myapp://import?url={url_encoded}

auto_open.title: Auto-open by file type
auto_open.description: Open matching files in an app instead of downloading them, as extension=app. Example: ipa=feather. Remove all entries to always download.

receive_dir.title: Receive folder
receive_dir.description: Where files uploaded from your phone are saved. Leave empty for your Downloads folder.

passcode.title: Passcode
passcode.description: Ask for a passcode on the phone before any transfer. Leave empty for none, "random" for a new 6-digit code every transfer (Claude tells you the code), or type your own fixed code. A fixed code is stored in plain text in settings.json.

theme.title: Color theme
theme.description: Colors of the pages on your phone (and the accent on the QR page). ocean = blue/cyan, violet = purple, mint = green, sunset = orange/pink, mono = black/white.

custom_colors.title: Custom colors
custom_colors.description: Optional: your own accent colors as one or two hex codes, e.g. #e11d48 or #e11d48,#f59e0b. Overrides the color theme. Leave empty to use the theme.

timeout_minutes.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeout_minutes.description: Stop serving if no download completes within this time.
